The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.




Estamos buscando um Analista de IA Pleno para se juntar ao nosso time no desenvolvimento de soluções de IA. Aqui não tem monotonia. Somos um time de solucionadores de desafios de clientes de grande porte nos mais diversos mercados.

title: Product Solutions Engineer
description:
About SEW

SEW.ai leading AI platforms that empower and engage billions of customers and workforce to global Power, Water, Gas , Solar and eMobility industry. As leading #1 SEW.ai platform provide world-class Customer Experience (CX) , Workforce Experience (WX) , Payment Experience (PX) , Intelligent Experience (iX) , Business Experience (BX) and Grid Experience (GX) platforms—helping billions of people Engage, Empower, and Educate themselves to save energy and water.


Quick Highlights

  • 420+ global clients across North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific
  • 1,550+ employees worldwide and rapidly growing
  • Millions of end users engaged monthly across digital platforms
  • 150+ global recognitions from leading industry publications and analyst organizations

SEW is a global, innovation-driven organization that values collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning while building solutions that accelerate digital transformation across the Energy and Utilities sector.


Role Summary

The Product Solutions Engineer is a senior individual contributor role within the Product Solution Engineering organization responsible for bridging customer business requirements with SEW platform capabilities. This role requires strong client-facing consulting expertise, deep Energy and Utilities domain knowledge, and the ability to translate complex technical and functional concepts into scalable product-driven solutions. In this role, you will also be responsible for building and maintaining innovation mindset with deep problem-solving trusted partner relationship with SEW.ai clients, helping them understand our current and future platform / product capabilities, and supporting them through their journey for next 5-10 years.


The candidate will work closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, and Delivery teams to design solution architectures, lead discovery workshops, and support strategic customer engagements across global markets.


This role requires approximately 30% travel to support customer workshops, transformation engagements, and strategic solution discussions.


Key Responsibilities

Client Engagement & Solution Consulting

  • Lead customer-facing discovery sessions and workshops to gather business, functional, and high-level technical requirements.
  • Map customer requirements to SEW platform capabilities and recommend scalable solution architectures aligned with product standards.
  • Provide consultative guidance based on Energy and Utilities industry best practices across areas such as Digital Customer Experience, Meter-to-Cash, DER, eMobility, and Workforce transformation.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders throughout pre-sales, implementation planning, and expansion phases.
  • Project management: Leading project timelines through Agile methodologies or other frameworks with precision for successful solution implementation
  • Lead technical solution discussions during and post sales cycles, including product demonstrations tailored to customer use cases.


Product & Architecture Alignment

  • Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence roadmap priorities based on market and customer insights.
  • Design high-level solution architectures integrating SaaS, cloud, and enterprise systems leveraging a platform first strategy.
  • Develop reusable solution frameworks, accelerators, and capability mappings.
  • Ensure alignment between customer-specific requirements and scalable product functionality.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery teams to support deal closures and ensure solution readiness.
  • Coordinate across architecture, engineering, and implementation teams to ensure solution feasibility and implementation success.
  • Support Agile delivery alignment through solution documentation and technical guidance.
  • Analyze product usage metrics and customer feedback to recommend enhancements that improve adoption and platform value.


Process Optimization & Innovation

  • Drive solution engineering best practices and standardized customer-facing deliverables.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the Product Engineering organization.
  • Support strategic transformation workshops and executive-level architecture discussions.


Required Qualifications

  • Previous experience in a client-facing Solution Engineering, Consulting, or Architecture role .
  • Trilingual (English, Portuguese, and Spanish) with professional proficiency in all three languages
  • Strong experience gathering business requirements and translating them into product and solution capabilities.
  • Experience providing industry best practice recommendations within the Energy and Utilities sector.
  • Demonstrated experience working with SaaS platforms, cloud architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • Prior experience working with global product organizations or system integrators supporting utilities.
  • Strong understanding of digital transformation across utility domains (CIS, CX, Grid, DER, eMobility, or Field Operations).
  • Ability to work effectively as an individual contributor while influencing global cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 30% .


Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Understanding of enterprise integration patterns and microservices architectures.
  • Working knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or C#.
  • Experience with web and mobile platforms and modern digital architecture frameworks.

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com .NET e AWS.


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • NET Core, AWS;
  • Conceitos de microserviços e aplicações distribuídas;
  • Testes unitários;
  • Conhecimento em REST APIs;
  • Docker, Kubernetes;
  • Desenvolvimento em Cloud AWS;
  • RDS MySQL e DynamoDB, AWS Lambda utilizando Python, ECS Fargate, Elastic Cache Redis, API Gateway, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, KMS, etc;

  • Serviço de Mensageria: KAFTA;
  • Experiência em CI/CD (CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild);

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;

  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

title: Professor de inglês empresarial
description:
Descrição da Empresa A COMUNIK IDIOMAS oferece treinamento empresarial e acadêmico online em diversos idiomas, como inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês e português, além de serviços de tradução. Também promovemos workshops corporativos voltados para apresentações, reuniões, negociações, viagens, conferências, elaboração de currículos e preparação para entrevistas e seleções de emprego e/ou acadêmicas como testes de proficiência. Nosso diferencial é a abordagem personalizada dos idiomas, com aulas de 60 minutos com professores exclusivos e o uso de plataformas online com conteúdos balizados internacionamente onde adaptamos o aprendizado às necessidades específicas do ambiente corporativo e/ou acadêmico de cada aluno.

Descrição do Cargo: Se você é um professor curioso, dinâmico, que não se acomodou com a mesma metodologia há anos e busca inovar nas suas aulas, gosta de tecnologia, busca conteúdos atualizados na internet e usa IA de forma criativa, este anúncio é para você!

Estamos contratando Professor (es) (as) de Inglês Empresarial para ministrar aulas de forma remota. Este cargo requer proficiência em inglês, a preparação e condução de aulas personalizadas de inglês, com foco em linguagem de negócios e necessidades corporativas específicas. O dia a dia inclui, além de metodologia CEFR a adaptação de materiais (realia), aplicação de avaliações e acompanhamento do progresso dos alunos. Este é um cargo contratado com flexibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota nos horários da manhã e após 17h00.

Qualificações

  • Ensino de inglês: Experiência em ensino da língua inglesa, com foco em conversação e aptidão para ministrar aulas eficazes e acessíveis a diferentes níveis de fluência.
  • Inglês empresarial: Conhecimento específico em inglês voltado ao ambiente de negócios, incluindo terminologia, comunicação corporativa e habilidades práticas para reuniões e negociações.

title: Backend/ Integration Developer
description:
Come to one of the largest IT services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make a difference, which is why we live in a culture of unlimited learning and full of opportunities for mutual improvement and development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Backend/ Integration Developer @ Remote- Brazil, who wants to learn and transform their career at TATA CONSULTANCY SERVICES .


Job Description:

Job Title: Backend/ Integration Developer

Experience : 5+ Years

Location : Remote -Brazil

Language : Fluent/Advanced English

Employment Type: (Permanent)


Integration Developer – IBM App Connect (ESB)

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Integration Developer with strong expertise in IBM App

Connect Enterprise (ACE) to design, develop, and deliver scalable integration solutions

across global enterprise platforms.

This role is part of the Global Integration Engineering team and focuses on enabling API-led,

event-driven, and cloud-native integrations that support enterprise digital transformation

initiatives. The ideal candidate brings a strong integration mindset, hands-on ESB

experience, and working knowledge of cloud platforms, automation, and modern

development practices.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and develop cloud-ready and hybrid integration solutions using IBM App

Connect / ACE.

• Build and expose RESTful APIs, event-driven services, and asynchronous integrations

aligned to enterprise architecture standards.

• Implement modern integration patterns including API-led connectivity, event

streaming, pub/sub, and request–reply.

• Develop integrations that are secure, scalable, resilient, and observable in cloud and

hybrid environments.

• Work closely with architects to evolve integration standards and support cloud

adoption and modernization initiatives.

• Integrate enterprise systems using messaging, APIs, file transfer, and streaming

technologies.

• Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and infrastructure-aware

integration design.

• Support non-functional requirements including performance, high availability,

disaster recovery, and security.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Cloud, DevOps, Security, QA, Product, and

Business).

• Participate in troubleshooting, production support, and continuous improvement of

integration platforms.

• Provide technical guidance and promote best practices across the integration

community.

• Contribute to knowledge sharing, documentation, and adoption of integration best

practices across the organization.

Core Skills & Experience (Required)

• Strong hands-on experience with IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM

Integration Bus (IIB).

• Proven expertise in:

o ESQL, DFDL

o REST & SOAP APIs

o JSON, XML, XSLT

o IBM MQ, JMS, HTTP/S

• Deep understanding of enterprise and cloud integration patterns.

• Experience designing integrations for high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance.

• Working knowledge of cloud platforms i.e. AWS

• Experience building or consuming cloud-native services and APIs.

• Programming experience in Java, including scripting and automation.

• Familiarity with Git-based version control and collaborative development workflows.

Nice to Have / Desirable Skills

• IIB / ACE certifications.

• Experience with MuleSoft or ETL or data integration tools (e.g., Informatica).

• Unix/Linux and shell scripting.

• Experience supporting global, large-scale enterprise platforms

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life Insurance
  • Transportation voucher
  • Meal/food vouchers
  • Childcare
  • Ginásio Pass
  • TCS Gems TCS Cares – toll-free 0800 that offers psychological (24 hours/day), legal, social and financial assistance to members
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Certification Reimbursement
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online Courses & Live Training
  • Opportunity for international experience

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring your friend – By referring people, you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

All our opportunities are based on these principles. We thought of different inclusion and social responsibility actions in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come be a TCSer!

title: Professor de Espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?


  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

title: Coordenador de Manutenção
description:
Para a posição de Coordenador de Manutenção , a atuação será voltada ao suporte das operações , com foco no acompanhamento de rotinas administrativas e operacionais.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar, programar e controlar as atividades de manutenção e grandes paradas de acordo com o programa de manutenção e com as prioridades operacionais;
  • Coordenar e garantir recursos humanos, materiais, peças, ferramentas e insumos necessários para a execução das tarefas de manutenção que necessitam do suporte de terra;
  • Ler e interpretar desenhos, esboços, tabelas, especificações técnicas, manuais ou instruções para validar ajustes, normas, tolerâncias e tudo que for necessário para execução do seu trabalho; Levantar fatos e dados relacionados a eventos para investigação (RCA);
  • Revisar e aprovar os serviços executados pelos fornecedores;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia de Produção, Mecânica, Automação, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou Naval;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Experiência com gestão de equipes;
  • Experiência no setor marítimo ou offshore.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em auditorias de sociedades classificadoras (ABS e DNV);
  • Conhecimento em Mecânica, Elétrica, Produção, Noções em Ciências navais e Navegação, Mecânica de propulsores e Lemes, Máquinas navais, Turbinas Sistemas de automação, Sistema de geração de energia, Sistemas hidráulicos, sistema de arrefecimento, Eletrônica, comunicação de rádios VHF e SSB e sistema Vsat;
  • Conhecimento em Serviços técnicos de produção, manutenção de sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos, vedações, montagens, conhecimento de sistemas offshore e operações dentro dos padrões técnicos;
  • Conhecimento em análise de causa raíz e/ou ferramentas de qualidade: 5W2H, diagrama de Ishikawa, diagrama de Pareto.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Modelo de Contratação:

PJ


Oferecemos :

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina remota de trabalho;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.



Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na oportunidade.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de priorização baseada em risco.
  • Comunicação clara para públicos técnicos e executivos.
  • Capacidade de estruturar processos e elevar maturidade organizacional.
  • Mentalidade colaborativa e orientada a governança preventiva.


Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida em Governança, Riscos e Compliance (GRC).
  • Vivência com ISO 27001/27002 e/ou NIST.
  • Experiência em auditorias e avaliação de controles.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de riscos corporativos.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações como: CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 LA/LI, PCI ISA.
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência com PCI DSS
  • Experiência com ferramentas de GRC.


Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Evolução do nível de maturidade em segurança.
  • Redução de riscos críticos.
  • Aderência comprovada a PCI DSS e demais normas.
  • Redução de não conformidades em auditorias.
  • Fortalecimento da cultura de governança e controles.


Contexto de Atuação

A posição integra o White Team, com foco em governança, prevenção, controles e maturidade do programa de Segurança da Informação, atuando de forma estratégica e transversal com múltiplas áreas de negócio.

title: Administrador de sistema e banco de dados
description:
Administrador de Banco de Dados

Buscamos um Administrador de Banco de Dados qualificado para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve possuir sólida experiência em MongoDB e Redis, e conhecimentos em PostgreSQL serão considerados um diferencial. Esta é uma oportunidade incrível para um profissional que deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador, contribuindo para a performance e segurança de nossos sistemas de dados.


Responsabilidades:

- Administrar e otimizar bancos de dados MongoDB e Redis, garantindo alta disponibilidade e desempenho.

- Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento na modelagem de dados e na criação de consultas eficientes.

- Implementar e gerenciar estratégias de backup e recuperação de dados para assegurar a integridade das informações.

- Monitorar o desempenho dos bancos de dados, realizando tuning e ajustes conforme necessário.

- Garantir a segurança dos dados, implementando políticas de acesso e controle de usuários.

- Documentar processos, procedimentos e melhores práticas relacionadas à administração de bancos de dados.

- Resolver problemas de banco de dados de maneira proativa, minimizando o tempo de inatividade.


Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada em administração de banco de dados MongoDB e Redis.

- Conhecimento prático em PostgreSQL será um diferencial.

- Habilidade em otimização de desempenho e troubleshooting.

- Familiaridade com práticas de backup, recuperação de dados e segurança.

- Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e se comunicar efetivamente com diferentes áreas da empresa.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência em ambientes de nuvem e soluções de banco de dados como serviço (DBaaS).

- Conhecimento em outras tecnologias de banco de dados NoSQL e relacionais.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior
description:
Somos o futuro da Gestão de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho!


SOBRE NÓS


A Vixting está revolucionando a Admissão Digital e a Gestão Ocupacional no Brasil!


Com tecnologia de ponta, oferecemos soluções práticas e inteligentes que simplificam a rotina dos nossos clientes. Aqui, nosso foco vai além de serviços: acreditamos nas pessoas e na força de conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão pelo que fazemos.


Acreditamos que cada pessoa tem um valor único e que o alinhamento cultural é o alicerce para relações duradouras e impactantes. Aqui, construímos conexões baseadas em confiança, ética e paixão por superar expectativas ✨


Criamos soluções estratégicas


Somos apaixonados pelo maior ativo de uma companhia: Pessoas! Prezamos a essência de cada ser humano, buscamos o fit cultural para ser a base da nossa relação. Construímos relacionamentos baseados em confiança, caráter, honestidade, ética e paixão por encantar!


DESENVOLVEDOR FULLSTACK SÊNIOR


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Core Técnico: Experiência sólida e comprovada em Node.js, React.js, TypeScript e JavaScript;
  • Cloud & Serverless: Vivência prática em ambiente AWS , com foco em arquitetura Serverless e AWS Lambda;
  • Mensageria: Experiência com sistemas de filas (especialmente AWS SQS);
  • Banco de Dados: Proficiência em MySQL e MongoDB;
  • DevOps: Experiência na configuração de fluxos de CI/CD com GitHub Actions;
  • Arquitetura: Conhecimento em quebra de monolitos e transição para microsserviços/serverless;
  • Produtividade: Utilização de ferramentas de IA no fluxo de trabalho diário para ganho de performance.


Diferenciais (Serão considerados um grande peso)

  • Conhecimento em DynamoDB (banco chave-valor).
  • Background no setor de Healthtech (especialmente medicina ocupacional).
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de software para RH, Recrutamento ou Onboarding.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto


Nossos Benefícios


Vale refeição de R$36,00 por dia, sendo 22 dias úteis fixos;


Auxilio creche para mamãe ou papai;


Plano de saúde Alice sem mensalidade;

title: Sr. Mainframe Developer (Assembler/COBOL)
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Sr. Mainframe Assembler & COBOL Developer to join an international project supporting a US client in the life insurance industry. This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to the maintenance, enhancement, and migration of critical mainframe-based insurance administration systems.



Main Challenges:


  • Maintain and enhance legacy mainframe systems written in Assembler and COBOL , working with VSAM file structures
  • Support and develop applications on the Ingenium platform (COBOL/DB2)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across multiple mainframe environments
  • Support ongoing data extraction and migration efforts toward a third-party administrator (TPA)
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and continuity
  • Provide knowledge transfer and documentation to preserve institutional knowledge


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience in mainframe development experience with COBOL (critical)
  • Hands-on experience with IBM Mainframe Assembler programming on z/OS
  • Proven background in life insurance or annuities systems (policy administration, claims, or billing)
  • Experience working with VSAM file structures on mainframe environments
  • Hands-on experience with DB2 on IBM mainframe
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in legacy/production environments
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English with US-based client teams


Preferred Background:


  • Familiarity with Ingenium or similar insurance administration platforms
  • Experience with data migration or system conversion projects
  • Exposure to CICS Transaction Gateway and Unix environments
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent


This role is especially relevant for professionals who have worked in life insurance mainframe environments, supported legacy system modernization, and are comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities in a direct, fast-paced team culture.
company: QAT Global | Custom Software Development & IT Staffing Solutions - US, Brazil & Costa Rica Nearshore

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

  • Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
  • Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
  • Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
  • Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.


What we expect from you:


  • Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
  • Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
  • Previous experience with Workday is a plus.


Soft Skills

  • Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution.
  • Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
  • Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.


What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: [Tech] Engenharia DevOps Sênior
description:
O especialista DevOps irá fazer parte do coração do time de operações de aplicações cloud native na execução e desenho da plataforma TOTVS Apps, através da evolução da infraestrutura de serviços, aplicativos, arquitetura e suas automatizações. A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, e cresce a cada dia, ampliando continuamente seu potencial de impacto e inovação.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe.
  • Realizar atividade de triagem dos tickets abertos pelos clientes internos através da classificação ou categorização dos mesmos quando necessário, por tipo de ticket ou status do atendimento.
  • Promover ações de melhoria através da participação ativa das cerimônias do Ágil (Daily, reabastecimento, reviews e retrospectivas)
  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/meta da área através da execução de suas atividades propostas
  • Identificar problemas de ambientes DevOps, integração contínua, e banco de dados implementando e inovando em soluções.
  • Estimular a equipe em processos de melhoria, usando seu conhecimento e experiência para identificar problemas e desenvolver soluções.
  • Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ambientes através da orientação dos demais integrantes do time no uso de boas práticas de DevOps.
  • Ser uma referência interna e externa em práticas DevOps, garantindo a sustentabilidade dos ambientes por meio da disseminação de conhecimento e participação de fóruns.
  • Realizar pesquisa e avaliação de novas tecnologias, ferramentas e práticas de mercado, com o objetivo de identificar e propor soluções que aprimorem a eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade dos ambientes e processos de desenvolvimento, integração e operação.

  • Metodologia Ágil – nível domínio;

title: [Tech] Engenharia DevOps Sênior
description:

A plataforma TOTVS Apps é utilizada por centenas de desenvolvedores e dezenas de produtos, e cresce a cada dia, ampliando continuamente seu potencial de impacto e inovação.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Orientar no processo de administração de dados e ambientes, através da execução de rotinas e ferramentas envolvidas na área, estipulando os prazos e prioridades da equipe.

  • Contribuir tanto para o cumprimento dos indicadores individuais (produtividade, pesquisa de satisfação e outros) quanto para o resultado/meta da área através da execução de suas atividades propostas

  • Estimular a equipe em processos de melhoria, usando seu conhecimento e experiência para identificar problemas e desenvolver soluções.
  • Garantir a sustentabilidade dos ambientes através da orientação dos demais integrantes do time no uso de boas práticas de DevOps.

title: Líder técnico
description:
Vaga: Tech Lead

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead para atuar como referência técnica, liderando squads e apoiando o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta qualidade.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente times de desenvolvimento
  • Apoiar definição de arquitetura e padrões técnicos
  • Garantir qualidade de código, boas práticas e evolução das soluções
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas complexos e decisões técnicas
  • Conectar áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócio

Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e atuação como Tech Lead ou referência técnica
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de aplicações, APIs e integrações
  • Vivência com revisão de código, boas práticas e ambientes ágeis
  • Experiência com pipelines, testes, versionamento e entrega contínua
  • Boa comunicação e perfil colaborativo

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com microsserviços, cloud e arquitetura distribuída
  • Vivência em transformação digital e sistemas de alta volumetria
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade, segurança e governança técnica

Perfil:

Buscamos um profissional com liderança técnica, visão estratégica, perfil hands-on e capacidade de influenciar times e decisões.


Atuação Remoto

Contratação PJ



A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante.


Essa oportunidade é preferencialmente para PcD, portanto, todos os profissionais com deficiência podem se candidatar.


Para isso, lembre-se de atualizar seu currículo com o número do CID e com um breve descritivo de sua deficiência para facilitar o processo de recrutamento e seleção.




Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e autodeterminados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!




Quer saber mais? Acesse:





Sobre a Softtek:


Fundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore.

title: Growth Business Development (Brazil) | Blockchain
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential Affiliates or KOLs
  • Support Affiliates or KOLs and design special campaigns to increase their trading volume
  • Build partnerships with Affiliates or KOLs and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing Affiliates or KOLs


Requirements


  • Proven working experience as a business development manager or a relevant role
  • Experience in channel development, market development
  • Deep understanding of crypto markets is a plus
  • Proficiency in English and local languages is essential


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits
